core_principle: Volume is the fuel of price movement. Price tells you what the market is doing; volume tells you how much conviction stands behind the move.

volume_confirms_trend.principle: Healthy trends are supported by volume expansion in the trend direction and volume contraction on counter-trend moves.

uptrend_healthy.interpretation: Buyers are aggressive and committed; sellers are passive on pullbacks
uptrend_healthy.action: maintain long bias; add on low-volume pullbacks

uptrend_unhealthy.interpretation: Buyers lack conviction; sellers are becoming more aggressive; distribution likely underway
uptrend_unhealthy.action: reduce long exposure; tighten stops; no new longs

downtrend_healthy.interpretation: Sellers are aggressive; buyers are passive on rallies
downtrend_healthy.action: maintain short bias; add on low-volume rallies

downtrend_unhealthy.interpretation: Sellers lack conviction; buyers are becoming more aggressive; accumulation likely underway
downtrend_unhealthy.action: reduce short exposure; tighten stops; no new shorts

climax_volume.definition: Extremely high volume — typically 2× to 5× average daily volume — occurring at the end of an extended trend move, signaling exhaustion of the dominant force.

selling_climax.context: occurs after a prolonged downtrend or sharp decline
characteristics: Price closes off the lows (closes in upper half of bar range)
Rapid price reversal follows within 1-3 bars
selling_climax.interpretation: Panic selling exhausted; supply overwhelmed by buyers willing to absorb at any price; potential major low
selling_climax.follow_up_expectation: Automatic rally (AR) follows; then secondary test on lower volume
selling_climax.trade_action: do not buy the climax bar; wait for AR and secondary test confirmation

buying_climax.context: occurs after a prolonged uptrend or sharp rally
characteristics: Price closes off the highs (closes in lower half of bar range)
Rapid price reversal follows within 1-3 bars
buying_climax.interpretation: Euphoric buying exhausted; demand overwhelmed by sellers (smart money distributing) at any price; potential major high
buying_climax.follow_up_expectation: Automatic reaction (AR) follows; then secondary test on lower volume
buying_climax.trade_action: do not short the climax bar; wait for AR and secondary test confirmation

dry_up_volume.definition: Volume that falls to significantly below average levels, indicating a temporary equilibrium where neither buyers nor sellers are aggressively active.

significance_at_support.interpretation: Supply has dried up at support; sellers are not interested in selling at current prices; price likely to bounce
significance_at_support.action: valid long entry area; reduced risk as there is little selling pressure

significance_at_resistance.interpretation: Demand has dried up at resistance; buyers are not interested in buying at current prices; price likely to decline
significance_at_resistance.action: valid short entry area; reduced risk as there is little buying pressure

significance_in_trend_pullback.interpretation: Correction is running out of momentum; prevailing trend participants not aggressively exiting; trend likely to resume
significance_in_trend_pullback.action: high probability entry in trend direction

obv_divergence.definition: OBV is a cumulative volume indicator: adds volume on up days and subtracts volume on down days. OBV divergence occurs when OBV trend disagrees with price trend.
obv_divergence.calculation: OBV_today = OBV_yesterday + (volume if close > prior close) or - (volume if close < prior close)

bullish_divergence.definition: Price makes lower lows but OBV makes higher lows
bullish_divergence.interpretation: Volume is accumulating on up days despite price declining; institutions buying on weakness; hidden accumulation underway
bullish_divergence.implication: Potential trend reversal to upside; price likely to follow OBV higher
bullish_divergence.action: watch for structural confirmation (CHOCH/BOS) to enter long
bullish_divergence.reliability: high when combined with Wyckoff accumulation events

bearish_divergence.definition: Price makes higher highs but OBV makes lower highs
bearish_divergence.interpretation: Volume is declining on up days despite price rising; institutions selling into strength; hidden distribution underway
bearish_divergence.implication: Potential trend reversal to downside; price likely to follow OBV lower
bearish_divergence.action: watch for structural confirmation (CHOCH/BOS) to enter short
bearish_divergence.reliability: high when combined with Wyckoff distribution events

confirmation.rule: OBV divergence alone is not a trade signal; require price structure confirmation (BOS/CHOCH) before acting
confirmation.false_signal_risk: OBV divergences can persist for extended periods in strong trends

volume_at_breakout.principle: A valid breakout from a consolidation range, resistance level, or chart pattern must be accompanied by above-average volume to be considered genuine.

minimum_volume_requirement.description: Breakout volume must be at least 1.5 times the 20-period average volume

low_volume_breakout.definition: Breakout occurs but volume is at or below average
low_volume_breakout.interpretation: Breakout lacks conviction; likely to fail or require retest before continuation
low_volume_breakout.action: do not chase; wait for retest of breakout level; if retest holds on low volume, then enter

high_volume_breakout.definition: Breakout occurs with volume 1.5× or more above average
high_volume_breakout.interpretation: Breakout has strong conviction; institutional participation likely; trend continuation probable
high_volume_breakout.action: valid entry on breakout or on first pullback to breakout level

climax_volume_on_breakout.definition: Breakout occurs with extreme volume (3× or more above average)
climax_volume_on_breakout.interpretation: May indicate buying/selling climax rather than continuation; risk of immediate reversal
climax_volume_on_breakout.action: be cautious; watch for reversal signals in next 1-3 bars; may be a false breakout on extreme volume

pattern_specific_requirements.flag_pennant_breakout: minimum 1.5× average; ideally 2× the volume seen during flag formation

accumulation_volume_patterns.definition: Volume patterns suggesting smart money is buying (accumulating) while price appears bearish or sideways

patterns.interpretation: Supply is drying up; sellers losing control

patterns.pattern: Up bars on increasing volume with above-average advance
High volume down bar that closes in upper half (SC pattern)
patterns.interpretation: Buyers absorbed all selling; demand overwhelmed supply

patterns.pattern: Test of lows on very low volume (dry-up at support)
patterns.interpretation: No selling interest at lows; accumulation confirmed

patterns.pattern: OBV rising while price is flat or declining
patterns.interpretation: Hidden accumulation; volume on up days exceeds volume on down days

distribution_volume_patterns.definition: Volume patterns suggesting smart money is selling (distributing) while price appears bullish or sideways

patterns.interpretation: Demand is drying up; buyers losing conviction

patterns.pattern: Down bars on increasing volume with above-average decline
High volume up bar that closes in lower half (BC pattern)
patterns.interpretation: Sellers absorbed all buying; supply overwhelmed demand

patterns.pattern: Test of highs on very low volume (dry-up at resistance)
patterns.interpretation: No buying interest at highs; distribution confirmed

patterns.pattern: OBV declining while price is flat or rising
patterns.interpretation: Hidden distribution; volume on down days exceeds volume on up days

effort_vs_result_principle.definition: The relationship between volume (effort) and price movement (result). When effort and result are misaligned, the dominant force is likely being absorbed by the opposing force.

cases.interpretation: Absorption — opposing force is absorbing all the effort; likely reversal zone
No resistance — price is moving into a vacuum; continuation likely until it meets supply/demand
Trend strength confirmed — effort and result aligned
Equilibrium — neither side interested; range likely to continue or major move pending

agent_rules.condition: price in uptrend; volume expanding on rally legs and contracting on pullback legs
agent_rules.action: confirm trend health; maintain long bias; enter on low-volume pullbacks

agent_rules.condition: price in uptrend; volume contracting on rallies and expanding on pullbacks
agent_rules.action: flag trend weakness; reduce long exposure; tighten trailing stops; no new long entries

agent_rules.condition: climax volume bar appears after extended trend move
agent_rules.action: mark as potential SC or BC; do not trade the bar; wait for AR and ST confirmation before positioning

agent_rules.condition: volume dries up at a key support level in an uptrend
agent_rules.action: classify as valid long entry; reduced downside risk; enter long with stop below the low

agent_rules.condition: volume dries up at a key resistance level in a downtrend
agent_rules.action: classify as valid short entry; reduced upside risk; enter short with stop above the high

agent_rules.condition: OBV making higher lows while price makes lower lows
agent_rules.action: flag bullish OBV divergence; watch for structural CHOCH or BOS bullish confirmation before entering long

agent_rules.condition: OBV making lower highs while price makes higher highs
agent_rules.action: flag bearish OBV divergence; watch for structural CHOCH or BOS bearish confirmation before entering short

agent_rules.condition: breakout from consolidation or key level with volume less than 1.5x 20-period average
agent_rules.action: classify as low-confidence breakout; do not chase; wait for retest of level; require volume confirmation on retest or reject signal

agent_rules.condition: breakout from consolidation or key level with volume 1.5x or more above 20-period average
agent_rules.action: classify as high-confidence breakout; valid entry on breakout bar close or first pullback to level

agent_rules.condition: high volume bar with little to no price progress at a key level
agent_rules.action: classify as absorption; opposing force is absorbing pressure; prepare for reversal; do not trade in direction of the absorbed force

agent_rules.condition: down bars occurring on decreasing volume in a declining market
agent_rules.action: flag potential accumulation volume pattern; sellers losing conviction; watch for SC and spring setup

agent_rules.condition: up bars occurring on decreasing volume in a rising market
agent_rules.action: flag potential distribution volume pattern; buyers losing conviction; watch for BC and UTAD setup
